developer: Bangladesh Agriculture Research Institute(BARI), Gazipur, Bangladesh
planting_time: Rabi: Mid November to Mid- December
harvest_time: Ripening time require in Rabi season 140-145 days and 95-100 days in Kharif season.
yield_t_ha: Yield in Rabi season 5.5-6 t/ha and 4-4.5 t/ha in Kharif season
main_characteristics: It is a composite variety. Deep anthocyanin and 1 st leaf sheath and medium pigmentation in leaf sheath at 2-leaf stage. Plant height is greater than local variety. Plant and ear height ranged from 200-210 cm and 100-105cm, respectively.   Ear is large size and pointed at the end, top portion of ear coating with hard coat, kernels are golden yellow and flint type. Grain yellow color and large size, 1000 grain weight 245-320 gram.
source_org: BARI, via BSMRAU Digital Herbarium of Crop Plants
